colombia.title: Alerta aérea en Japón: interceptan dos aeronaves vinculadas a Rusia y exigen explicaciones a Moscú

mundo.title: Ukraine Attacks Kerch Bridge Linking Russia to Occupied Crimea
mundo.snippet: The attacks, far from the front lines, forced the only bridge between Russia and the occupied Crimean Peninsula to close. Traffic on two bridges in Kyiv was also stopped.
